description: Read the responses that visitors sent through one form of a project, newest first, 100 at a time.

before.description: The next value of an earlier call. Lists the responses older than that page.

form.description: The form key, such as contact for /_form/contact. Required when the project has several forms.

project.description: The project key, such as client-report.

name: list_responses

form.description: null when the project has no responses yet.

next.description: The ID of the last response. Pass as before to read older responses. null when no older responses exist.

email.description: The verified email of a signed-in respondent; null without sign-in.

fields.description: In the order sent. A name repeats for a checkbox group.

title: List form responses
